description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view component named 'OpenClawChatView' used for a chat interface within an app. It manages message display, scroll behavior, and various UI states related to a chat session, including loading, errors, and onboarding states.

classes.name: OpenClawChatView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that renders a chat interface with message list, input composer, and status overlays.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout, including message list, composer, and error/empty state overlays.

methods.name: messageList
methods.description: Constructs the scrollable list of chat messages and related UI elements.

methods.name: mergeToolResults
methods.description: Merges tool result messages into previous messages to display combined content.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message has role indicating it's a tool result.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message should be visible based on its content and current UI settings.
